title: HR Administrator
description:
HR Administrator

Manchester City Centre£13.46 per hourTemporary Contract: 24th August 2026 - 30th October 202640 Hours per WeekOffice-Based 5 Days per WeekWorking Hours: 8:00am - 4:00pm or 9:00am - 5:00pm

We are currently recruiting for a HR Administrator to join a busy and fast-paced HR team in Manchester City Centre on a temporary basis. This is a fantastic opportunity for an organised and detail-oriented individual to gain valuable experience within a professional HR environment.

The successful candidate will provide administrative support across a range of HR activities, ensuring employee records, documentation and processes are maintained accurately and efficiently throughout the employee lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
- Providing general administrative support to the HR team
- Maintaining and updating employee records and HR systems
- Processing new starter and leaver documentation
- Preparing contracts, letters and other HR correspondence
- Managing HR inboxes and responding to employee queries
- Supporting onboarding and induction processes
- Organising meetings and maintaining HR calendars
- Assisting with absence and holiday records
- Ensuring all documentation is accurate, compliant and up to date
- Handling confidential employee information with discretion

About You
- Previous HR administration experience is essential
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
- Ability to prioritise workload and manage multiple tasks
- Professional, reliable and able to maintain confidentiality

If you're an organised HR administrator and available to start on 24th August 2026, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today!

We use generative AI tools to support our candidate screening process. This helps us ensure a fair, consistent, and efficient experience for all applicants. Rest assured, all final decisions are made by our hiring team, and your application will be reviewed with care and attention.

title: HR Administrator
description:
Administrator (HR & Compliance) - Ashton Under Lyne (Tameside)

Part Time - 15 hours per week (negotiable)

A well-established Manufacturing Company requires a proactive HR Administration and Compliance co-ordinator to support our people processes while overseeing key business compliance activities.

This varied role combines day to day HR administration with responsibility for maintaining compliance systems relating to environmental, product and regulatory requirements.

You would work within an experienced friendly administrative team who share the responsibility of ensuring the business operates efficiently and within a positive working environment.

Responsibilities Include:
- Administration of payroll preparation and maintaining employee records.
- Support company policies and HR procedures.
- Maintain compliance documentation, certifications and audit records.
- Liaise with suppliers and certification bodies to ensure ongoing compliance.
- Assist with internal audits and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Support the management team and wider business administration.

Ideal Skills & Experience:
- Previous experience in HR administration, or
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Strong communication and organisational skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office.
- Willingness to develop knowledge of environmental and product compliance through training.

Salary: £Competitive + Benefits including discretionary bonus scheme, pension, a secure key position working alongside senior management, friendly working environment in purpose-built factory.

To apply for this role, please press the apply button. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within 14 days. Thank you for your interest in the role.
